incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - Elevated error rates and partial routing failures affecting AquilaPay (enterprise dedicated EU cluster). Auto-page generated to #incidents and oncall at 03:12 UTC. thread_ts 3425007777
Nora Vega: i'm taking first watch. seeing ~35% 5xx on eu-dedicated-2, started ~03:09 UTC. requests to /v1/generate failing intermittently.
James Liu: confirmed. tailing proxy logs now — saw sustained connection drops to the allocator pool and increased queuing.
Omar Ruiz: support notes from AquilaPay ops: some payment webhook retries and message delivery delays. CSM (Priyanka) is on the call with their infra. this needs a high-touch customer notify.
Claire Benson: quick mitigation options: 1) shift AquilaPay traffic to eu-dedicated-failover (cross-region) 2) enable "latency-lite" fallback model to reduce backend load 3) apply temporary rate-limit on AquilaPay batch jobs (they launched a bulk sync at 03:05) 4) scale allocator pod replicas + bump redis connections. recommend 1 + 2 + 3 now.
Nora Vega: agreed. Omar, can you coordinate the account message? James/Alice (SRE) - please run shift and enable fallback.
James Liu: initiating traffic shift: executing `redwoodctl routing shift --customer AP-4433 --to eu-dedicated-failover --percent 100`
ops-bot: routing command accepted. shifting AquilaPay traffic to eu-dedicated-failover (customer_id: AP-4433). Change applied at 03:18:42 UTC.
James Liu: enabling fallback model "latency-lite-v1" for AP-4433 routing policy.
ops-bot: fallback model enabled: latency-lite-v1 for customer AP-4433.
Nora Vega: initial metrics after shift: 5xx from 34% -> 12% within 5m. latency p95 improved slightly. still some spikes.
Omar Ruiz: AquilaPay CSM reports they see intermittent webhook failures to downstream. They want an ETA and an account-specific status tile. I'm drafting message.
Claire Benson: applying rate-limit to their batch job user-agent (agent: AquilaSync/2.1) to 20 req/s to stop stampeding.
ops-bot: rate-limit rule applied for AquilaSync/2.1 -> 20 rps at 03:22:10 UTC.
James Liu: scaled allocator replicas from 6 -> 10 on eu-dedicated-failover cluster. pods coming up, ready in ~70s.
Nora Vega: helpful—errors down to ~6% after scale + rate-limit. good improvement.
Omar Ruiz: draft account email for AquilaPay: "We detected elevated request failures impacting your EU dedicated deployment starting 03:09 UTC. We shifted traffic to a healthy failover pool and enabled a lower-latency fallback model, and applied temporary throttling to your bulk sync jobs. These mitigations reduced error rates; some retries may still occur. We expect normal behavior within 20-40 minutes. Full timeline and RCA will follow."
Nora Vega: please include exact impacted windows and invite them to a post-incident call. add contacts: ops@aquilapay.com, legal@aquilapay.com, priya.csm@redwood.ai
Omar Ruiz: composing outbound now. Will paste below for record and for status page.
Omar Ruiz: ---OUTBOUND EMAIL START---
Subject: Incident: Service degradation affecting AquilaPay (EU dedicated) — Mitigation underway
To: ops@aquilapay.com, legal@aquilapay.com
CC: priya.csm@redwood.ai, omar.ruiz@redwood.ai

Hi AquilaPay Team,

We observed elevated request failures affecting your EU dedicated deployment beginning 03:09 UTC. Our engineers performed the following mitigations: (1) shifted your traffic to a healthy failover pool, (2) enabled a fallback model (latency-lite-v1) to reduce backend memory/CPU pressure, and (3) applied a temporary throttle to bulk-sync traffic.

Impact window: approx 03:09 - ongoing; error rates reduced from ~35% -> ~6% after mitigations. Expected restoration: 20-40 minutes.

If you'd like a post-incident call, please let us know a preferred time and we'll arrange an on-call engineering brief.

Regards,
Omar Ruiz
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
---OUTBOUND EMAIL END---

Claire Benson: for public status page: propose public blurb: "We are investigating elevated errors impacting select EU dedicated deployments. Mitigations (traffic shift + fallback model + throttling) in progress. Some customers may experience request retries or delays. Updates at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3425007777"
Nora Vega: also request private tile for AquilaPay with explicit customer impact statement: "AquilaPay: Elevated 5xx and webhook retries in EU dedicated cluster starting 03:09 UTC. Traffic shifted to failover; fallback model enabled; throttling applied to bulk sync. Partial degradation remains; engineers monitoring."
ops-bot: Status page updated: public blurb + private AquilaPay tile.
Support Bot: canned response created for support channel: "We're aware of intermittent errors for some EU dedicated customers. AquilaPay-specific mitigations are in progress; customers impacted should contact their TAM or reply to the incident email."
James Liu: logs snippet showing connection resets and redis backlog at 03:11-03:16 UTC: ```
WARN allocator: queue_depth=112 at 2026-03-15T03:11:48Z
ERR connection: RESET by peer at 2026-03-15T03:12:04Z
ERR redis: BUSY at 2026-03-15T03:12:37Z
```
Nora Vega: action items: James - RCA & logs bundle; Claire - update postmortem template with customer impact numbers; Omar - send outbound email (sent) + schedule post-incident call if requested; Nora - handoff at 04:00 UTC to next oncall.
Claire Benson: starting timeline capture now and will estimate number of affected requests from logs (approx sketch: 12k requests during window).
Nora Vega: next oncall handoff: @Nora Vega -> @James Liu at 04:00 UTC. James, you'll own monitoring and final restore.
James Liu: roger. i'll take over and continue diagnostics.
ops-bot: Escalation rule: if 5xx > 15% for 10m -> page SRE lead. Threshold configured at 03:25:00 UTC.
Omar Ruiz: posted private account status tile and sent outbound email (copy saved in /var/backups/incidents/3425007777/aquilapay_outbound_email.txt).
Nora Vega: monitoring shows recovery trend; keeping thread open. will post updates at 04:00 or sooner if regression.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigations applied; error rate trending down to ~6%. Next scheduled update at 04:00 UTC or on threshold breach. Reference: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3425007777
